question: Which of these sentences best describe the ongoing action(s) in the video 1?

Using the right hand, close the door to access the refrigerator.
Close the door to the cabinet below by pushing it in with the  right hand while holding the saucepan by its handle.
Close door with right hand whilst holding dirty plate with left hand.
correct_answer: Using the right hand, close the door to access the refrigerator.
